publishedRoute.transportAddress: deterministic Sandbox Durable Object identity; no IP address is assigned or persisted

metadataGates: route role is production and activeSlot matches identity slot
durable runtime exists and descriptor status is running
descriptor and manifest revisions match the route
descriptor and manifest service ports match route servicePort
routeAssessment.processCriterion: saved process id resolves and Sandbox process status is running or starting
routeAssessment.freshStartCriterion: kill prior processes, start sealed app with HOST=0.0.0.0 and PORT=8080, then waitForPort on manifest healthPath for HTTP 200-399 for at most 30000ms at 250ms intervals
routeAssessment.failureBoundary: after durable metadata checks, in process/port availability assessment
routeAssessment.classificationGap: non-timeout containerFetch exceptions are caught without inspecting or recording the exception and returned as published_runtime_unavailable; process-not-running with an unavailable recovery claim returns the same code

adoptionVersusFreshStart.adopted: the deterministic production-publish start idempotency operation replayed its prior terminal; no materialize/start/waitForPort side effect ran during this publish
adoptionVersusFreshStart.fresh: a new start execution persists starting, materializes the exact sealed artifact, starts the fixed tenant process, waits for healthPath on port 8080, then persists processId, status running, and a new readyAt
adoptionVersusFreshStart.registrationDifference: adoption retained the prior durable processId/readyAt/running descriptor; fresh start would replace processId/readyAt only after a successful live port check
adoptionVersusFreshStart.routeVisibility: the route sees identity, slot, manifest revision, service port, and durable descriptor state; it does not see a separately persisted port-readiness fact

clockAudit.headerBound: AbortSignal timeout duration, not wall time

observabilityLimits.containerLogs: Cloudflare Container Observability disabled; no application log trail
observabilityLimits.ssh: disabled; enabling requires config and Worker redeploy and was not attempted
observabilityLimits.rawDurableObjectKv: Cloudflare Data Studio rejected _cf_KV.key reads with SQLITE_AUTH
observabilityLimits.directListenerInspection: not available without changing the frozen system
observabilityLimits.wranglerInstanceRead: application-level inventory only; per-instance id passed to containers info returned not found and Wrangler then emitted a Windows libuv assertion
